messages:
Anna (PM): Quick sync to lock scope for quotas + billing fields before we freeze MVP. Customers want per-route limits, clear token accounting (incl. function calls), and predictable error semantics. Proposing minimal ship that solves most cases.

Miguel (Eng): Agree on minimal. Gateway can tag by route and increment token counters. Streaming requires incremental increments when chunks are emitted. Must ensure idempotency for chunk retries.

Priya (Product): From field: top asks = per-route token caps, project-wide monthly budget alerts, and distinct 429 vs 403 so customers can automate retry vs auth flows. For MVP focus on: route token caps + response billing fields + console-based limits.

Elliot (Finance): Need canonical response fields for invoicing. No nested objects. Suggested names: usage_prompt_tokens, usage_completion_tokens, usage_function_tokens, usage_embedding_units, usage_total_units, billing_account_id. We will map these straight to invoice lines.

Kai (DevEx): SDK/docs needs a tiny example showing function call token splits and streaming. Also show sample rate config in console and SDK. Example config idea:

```
rate_limits:
  - route: /v1/chat
    tokens_per_minute: 200000
    requests_per_minute: 60
    on_exhaust: 429
  - route: /v1/embeddings
    tokens_per_minute: 50000
    requests_per_minute: 120
```

Anna (PM): Proposed launch acceptance checks (MVP):
- API always includes flat billing fields (no nested).
- Enforced per-route token budgets plus project aggregate.
- 429 error for quota exhaustion with structured body containing quota_scope and retry_after.
- Docs + SDK examples for streaming + function calls.
- Console: per-route quota view and simple alerting (email/webhook).
- Finance: mapping to invoice lines validated.

Miguel (Eng): Implementation risks and mitigations:
- Streaming double-count on chunk retry -> mitigation: idempotent chunk ids + commit/rollback markers.
- Function calls: attribute tool-call tokens back to originating request and mark them as usage_function_tokens.
- Mixed endpoints (embedding + chat) -> backend can compute both units; add usage_embedding_units distinct from token counts.

Priya (Product): Scope compromise: ship chat + embeddings accounting + per-route caps now. Defer reserved capacity / dedicated burst to Dedicated product (enterprise add-on). That covers ~80% of pilot asks.

Elliot (Finance): Also require a 6-month backward-compatible migration for customers using legacy usage_tokens. We'll emit both legacy and new fields for the window and send migration notes.

Kai (DevEx): Sample 429 body proposal for docs/SDKs:

```json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "quota_scope": "route:/v1/chat",
  "retry_after": 42,
  "usage": {"usage_prompt_tokens": 120, "usage_completion_tokens": 300, "usage_total_units": 420} 
}
```

(note: actual API should keep usage as flat top-level fields; this example shows semantics)

Anna (PM): Open decisions for EOD: 1) expose both token and embedding unit fields in all mixed responses? 2) default behavior on exhaustion: 429 vs short transparent queuing? 3) route limit control surface: console-only vs API at launch?

Miguel (Eng): From infra: we can return both fields for mixed requests; 429 default (queueing risks latency SLOs); console-only config for MVP to limit ACL complexity.

Priya (Product): Draft launch message: "Per-route quotas and explicit billing fields are available. Enterprise reserved capacity and advanced controls coming soon." Keeps expectations clear.

Elliot (Finance): We'll prepare a small schema doc for billing fields and an export spec so downstream ETL teams can ingest easily.

Kai (DevEx): Tests: unit tests for token attribution (stream + func + embeddings), e2e that simulates bursts to exercise 429, and an example app showing cost calc per request.

Anna (PM): Owners + ETA: Miguel -> metering design + idempotent chunking (2w). Kai -> SDK + examples + sample app (1w). Elliot -> billing schema + migration plan (1w). Priya -> pilot customer comms + launch messaging (1w). Anna -> finalize acceptance checklist and freeze scope (2d).

Miguel (Eng): I'll open design doc + infra PRs this week and tag reviewers.

Priya (Product): I'll line up two pilot customers for early validation of billing fields.

Anna (PM): If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll freeze scope and kick off. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
